scope: Proposition 4.2 (Power certificate) of the manuscript “Foulkes' conjecture for the sixth symmetric power” (preprints/Foulkes-Conjecture-for-the-Sixth-Symmetric-Power-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 210 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6439c44d77b7de4b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose Q(x) ≥ C > 0, where C is an integer and w(x) = 6d0 with d0 > 0. Put z = min ( 18, min { h ≥ 0 : ( d0 + h h ) ≥ C }) . Then for all k ≥ 1, Q(kx) ≥ f(C, z, k). (7)
